neighbours.label: the token apparent
fire: The son became heir apparent after the abdication.
For no apparent cause, the engine stalled.
The apparent motion of the stars puzzled them.
Despite his apparent calm, he was terrified.
It soon became apparent that the money was gone.
The apparent winner gave a short speech.
With apparent ease she lifted the crate.
Her apparent lack of interest annoyed the coach.
quiet: The son became king after the abdication.
For no good cause, the engine stalled.
The yearly motion of the stars puzzled them.
Despite his outward calm, he was terrified.
It soon became clear that the money was gone.
The likely winner gave a short speech.
With great ease she lifted the crate.
Her obvious lack of interest annoyed the coach.
